default.notes: Apply for the eVisa at evisa.e-gov.kg before travel; nationalities outside the eVisa scheme must apply at a Kyrgyz embassy.

groups.notes: Visa-free for up to 60 days per visit under Kyrgyzstan's visa-free regime.
Visa-free under CIS-era agreements — stays of up to 90 days are routine; check registration rules for longer stays.

KG.notes: Home country — no entry requirements for Kyrgyz citizens.

TR.notes: Visa-free under the bilateral agreement, commonly reported as up to 90 days — confirm the exact allowance before a long stay.

AF.notes: Not covered by the eVisa scheme — apply at a Kyrgyz embassy; an invitation and additional vetting are usually required.

XK.notes: Kyrgyzstan does not recognise Kosovo — travel on a Kosovo-issued passport is generally not possible; contact a Kyrgyz embassy about alternatives.
